# Nambi Crackers

Nambi Crackers is a Sivakasi-based fireworks supplier serving customers across India. We offer a full range of crackers, sparklers, flower pots, rockets, sky shots, and festival products with direct factory pricing and 90% off MRP offers.

- Business name: Nambi Crackers
- Location: Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, India
- Website: https://www.nambicrackers.in
- Contact: +91 63816 55906
- Email: nambicrackersorder@gmail.com
- Minimum order: ₹3,000
- Delivery: India-wide for confirmed orders with tracked dispatch
- Compliance: orders are handled as direct enquiry confirmation and billing through the shop, in line with Supreme Court guidance on fireworks sales
